about: Real names from reference/pc-inventory (one sample at three FAIMS CVs): no condition looks like a control.
question: Why is it asking me which condition is the control?

model.content:
None of the three conditions looks like a control, so Ionomos used CS_isoDTB_ELK_3_1-7_DIA_CV-35 and asks you to confirm [issue:NO_CONTROL] [job:2].

Pick the control in the window and Run analysis; the choice is remembered for this experiment [help:issue.NO_CONTROL].
